description: Delete a job posting from your company on Himalayas. This action cannot be undone, and any paid extras on the posting go with it. Deleting takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is deleted, and the reply shows the posting with a confirm_token; calling again with the same job_slug and that token deletes it. Show the user the posting and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

confirm_token.description: Leave out to see what would be deleted; nothing is deleted. Pass the token from that reply to delete it

name: delete_company_job
title: Delete company job
